name: 28940-multiimage-qwen3vl4b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct -- 8.88 GB of bf16 safetensors, public and ungated.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. One GPU, no router, no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 300 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm, one turn: sixteen distinct 448x448 gradient PNG images plus ~48 tokens of text in, 32 tokens out, with ignore_eos: true and temperature 0.0. Built as seventeen data sources -- one synthetic_text and sixteen synthetic_image, each with images_per_request: 1 and its own seed -- because guidellm reads a numeric column suffix as a TURN INDEX, so one source with images_per_request: 16 emits a sixteen-turn conversation of one image each instead of one request carrying sixteen.
purpose: A vision assistant answering one-turn questions about sixteen images each with a 4B model on one GPU.
launch:
# sglang launch arguments: one H100 serving a 4B vision-language model over the
# OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint.
model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct
tp-size: 1
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
keep-mm-feature-on-device: true
disable-radix-cache: true
random-seed: 42

# host / port / served-model-name are owned by whatever starts the server. Everything not listed
# here is a stock default of the pinned commit.
